summary: Iteration 8 retest of owner_identity persistence bug fix. BACKEND: 6/6 pytest tests PASS (100%) confirming PUT /api/providers/me with {business_name, category_id, owner_identity:'american'} now persists — subsequent GET /api/providers/me returns owner_identity='american'. Toggle latino↔american works both ways. Filter regression /api/providers?owner_identity=latino|american still returns the expected providers. /api/providers/featured 200. FRONTEND E2E: Logged in as demo.provider@getamano.com, navigated to /dashboard/provider, opened Perfil tab, clicked data-testid='form-owner-identity-american' (button reflected active styling — border rgb(24,95,165) + boxShadow set), clicked 'Guardar cambios'. Live API probe from the browser context returned {status:200, owner_identity:'american'} confirming persistence from the UI save button. After hard reload + reopen Perfil tab, the american button still shows the active styling (border rgb(24,95,165), boxShadow present) while latino shows inactive (no shadow, border rgb(166,225,218)). Restored demo provider to owner_identity='latino' at end. Regression: all 4 legal routes (/terminos /privacidad /politica-resenas /cookies) return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3172 lines; modularization still recommended (split into auth, providers, messaging, admin, promo, ads, market-pulse modules).

ProviderProfileIn now correctly includes owner_identity: Optional[Literal['latino','american']]. The dedicated helper endpoint PUT /api/providers/me/owner-identity is now redundant for the latino/american toggle and could be deprecated, or kept solely for the 'clear to None' case (since ProviderProfileIn default of None means a PUT without owner_identity will NOT clear it — confirm intended behavior).

Migration step that backfills owner_identity=None for old profiles is idempotent — good. Seed for demo provider now sets owner_identity='latino', preventing the migration from nulling it. Consider documenting in a migration log.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix from iteration 7 is fully resolved. The previously failing flow (ProviderDashboard Perfil 'Guardar cambios' button → PUT /api/providers/me payload missing owner_identity) is now persisted correctly because the field was added to the ProviderProfileIn Pydantic model. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/iteration8_owner_identity_persist_test.py can be re-run as regression. Two transient 401s on console for /api/auth/me before session check remain (pre-existing).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause confirmed: ProviderProfileIn (line 239 of server.py) was missing the owner_identity field. The PUT /api/providers/me endpoint deserializes its body through ProviderProfileIn, so Pydantic silently dropped owner_identity even though the frontend was including it in the save payload. Fix: add `owner_identity: Optional[Literal['latino','american']] = None` to ProviderProfileIn. Verified end-to-end via backend tests + browser E2E save + API probe + reload.
